item.description: Phaidklis Dorgratidis ~1473 was born in Anthemoessa to Dorkrates #981 and Antimdotos #2120, the first Leaf of their line.

item.title: Nikeia #1963 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus).
item.description: Nikeia #1963 was broken in the archipelago (fell in the war of Field of Ares and Iolcus). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
